executive_summary.question: What is the punishment for murder under BNS section 103, and how does it change when a group of five or more persons acting in concert commits murder on grounds such as race, caste, or community?
executive_summary.generated_answer:
**Murder – BNS § 103**

- **Basic offence ( § 103(1) )**  
  *“Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.”*【ac6c1423-8651-4ff8-9f26-0cf720a5f981】

- **Group offence ( § 103(2) )** – when **five or more persons acting in concert** commit murder **on the ground of race, caste, community, sex, place of birth, language, personal belief or any other similar ground**:  
  *“each member of such group shall be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.”*【ac6c1423-8651-4ff8-9f26-0cf720a5f981】

**Effect of the group provision**  
The punishment does **not increase** beyond the basic murder penalty; it remains **death or life imprisonment plus a fine** for each participant. The provision merely extends the same penalty to every member of the qualifying group.【01858be4-6a44-4c78-ad2e-9d51a448976b】 (which lists “Murder by group of five or more persons – Death or imprisonment for life and fine”).  

Thus, under BNS § 103, murder is punishable by death or life imprisonment (with fine), and the same penalty applies to each member of a group of five or more who commits murder on the specified discriminatory grounds.

evidence_analysis.claim_text: Under BNS § 103(1), whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
evidence_analysis.supporting_evidence:
Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder, shall be punished
with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be
less than five years but which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine, if the
act by which the death is caused is done with the intention of causing death, or of causing
such bodily injury as is likely to cause death; or with imprisonment of either description for
a term which may extend to ten years and with fine, if the act is done with the knowledge that
it is likely to cause death, but without any intention to cause death, or to cause such bodily
injury as is likely to cause death.

The punishment for the group offence does not increase beyond the basic murder penalty.
